# AttractorNeuralNetwork

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A recurrent neural network whose dynamics converge to stable fixed points (attractors) representing stored memories or states. Serves as a core computational primitive for implementing associative memory and pattern completion in TCC/iNEST architectures.
